# TCGA kirc dataset analysis 

## Load data 

```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(TCGAbiolinks)

query.exp <- GDCquery(
    project = "TCGA-KIRC", 
    data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
    data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification", 
    workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
    sample.type = c("Primary Tumor")
)

GDCdownload(
    query = query.exp,
    files.per.chunk = 100
)

kirc.exp <- GDCprepare(
    query = query.exp, 
    save = TRUE, 
    save.filename = "KIRCexp.rda"
)
```

## Add clinical/survival/mutation info

```{r}
kirc.clean <- kirc.exp
kirc.clean$PID <- kirc.clean$patient
kirc.clean$sample_id <- kirc.clean$sample

# Filter metadata
colData(kirc.clean) <- DataFrame(colData(kirc.clean) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, sample_id, barcode, sample_type, primary_diagnosis, prior_treatment, race, gender, ajcc_pathologic_t, ajcc_pathologic_n, ajcc_pathologic_m))

# Add from UCSC Xena 
## Clinical
clinical_xena <- as.data.frame(read_delim("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/data/TCGAKIRC_clinical.txt"))
clinical_xena$PID <- clinical_xena$bcr_patient_barcode

## Add relevant data based on PID
for (entry in colnames(clinical_xena)[colnames(clinical_xena) %in% c("neoplasm_histologic_grade")]) {
  colData(kirc.clean)[,entry] <- clinical_xena[,entry][match(colData(kirc.clean)[,"PID"],clinical_xena$PID)]
}

## Survival
survival_xena <- as.data.frame(read_delim("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/data/TCGAKIRC_survival.txt"))
survival_xena$PID <- survival_xena$`_PATIENT`

survival_xena$status_OS <- survival_xena$OS
survival_xena$OS_days <- survival_xena$OS.time

for (entry in colnames(survival_xena)[colnames(survival_xena) %in% c("status_OS", "OS_days")]) {
  colData(kirc.clean)[,entry] <- survival_xena[,entry][match(colData(kirc.clean)[,"PID"],survival_xena$PID)]
}


## Mutation
mutation_xena <- as.data.frame(read_delim("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/data/TCGAKIRC_mutation.txt"))
mutation_xena <- mutation_xena %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:ncol(mutation_xena), names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "mutation")
mutation_xena$gene <- mutation_xena$sample
mutation_xena$sample <- NULL
mutation_xena$PID <- str_split(mutation_xena$sample_id, "-0",simplify = TRUE)[,1]

## Filter for genes of interest
GOI_IntOGen <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/IntOGen_DriverGenes_CCRCC.tsv")
GOI <- GOI_IntOGen$Symbol

mutation_xena <- mutation_xena %>% filter(gene %in% GOI) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "gene", values_from = "mutation") %>% select(-TGFBR2, -ARHGEF10L, -PTPRK, -RAP1GDS1)

mutation_xena_filtered <- mutation_xena %>% select(PID, VHL, BAP1, PBRM1, SETD2, PTEN, NF2) %>% as.data.frame

for (entry in colnames(mutation_xena_filtered)[colnames(mutation_xena_filtered) %in% c("VHL", "BAP1", "PBRM1", "SETD2", "PTEN", "NF2")]) {
  colData(kirc.clean)[,entry] <- mutation_xena_filtered[,entry][match(colData(kirc.clean)[,"PID"],mutation_xena_filtered$PID)]
}
```


## Cleanly annotate data

```{r}
## Combine relevant disease progression categories and set colors
### Tumor stage
unique(kirc.clean$ajcc_pathologic_t)
kirc.clean$pT_simple <- str_split(kirc.clean$ajcc_pathologic_t, "", simplify = TRUE)[,2]
kirc.clean$pT_combined <- ifelse(kirc.clean$pT_simple %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(kirc.clean$pT_simple %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", kirc.clean$pT_simple))
unique(kirc.clean$pT_combined)

### ISUP grade 
unique(kirc.clean$neoplasm_histologic_grade)
kirc.clean$ISUP_simple <- str_split(kirc.clean$neoplasm_histologic_grade, "", simplify = TRUE)[,2]
kirc.clean$ISUP_combined <- ifelse(kirc.clean$ISUP_simple %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(kirc.clean$ISUP_simple %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", NA))
unique(kirc.clean$ISUP_combined)
```

### Filter patients with more than one sample (n=4)

Optional: One could also use the median counts per gene 

```{r}
PID_select <- colData(kirc.clean) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(PID) %>% dplyr::count() %>% filter(n > 1) %>% pull(PID)
# n = 4

kirc.clean <- kirc.clean[,!kirc.clean$PID %in% PID_select]
```


```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(matrixStats)

# Extract patient identifiers
patient_ids <- colData(kirc.clean)[, "PID"]

# Function to summarize the assays by patient ID using median
summarize_assay_by_pid <- function(assay_matrix, patient_ids) {
  unique_pids <- unique(patient_ids)
  summarized_matrix <- sapply(unique_pids, function(pid) {
    rowMedians(as.matrix(assay_matrix[, patient_ids == pid]), na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  colnames(summarized_matrix) <- unique_pids
  return(summarized_matrix)
}

# Summarize each assay in the SummarizedExperiment
assay_list <- lapply(assays(kirc.clean), summarize_assay_by_pid, patient_ids)

# Summarize colData
colData_new <- colData(kirc.clean) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(-sample_id, -barcode) %>% unique()
rownames(colData_new) <- colData_new$PID

# Create a new SummarizedExperiment object with summarized assays and colData
new_kirc.clean <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = assay_list,
  rowData = rowData(kirc.clean),
  colData = colData_new
)
colData_old <- colData(kirc.clean) %>% as.data.frame

# Double-check that summarization worked
## Patient with three samples - should only be partly TRUE
summary(assay(new_kirc.clean, "unstranded")[,"TCGA-B2-3923"] == assay(kirc.clean, "unstranded")[,"TCGA-B2-3923-01B-10R-A277-07"])

## Patinet with one sample - should be TRUE
summary(assay(new_kirc.clean, "unstranded")[,"TCGA-B8-5551"] == assay(kirc.clean, "unstranded")[,"TCGA-B8-5551-01A-01R-1541-07"])
```

```{r}
# Re-assign to old name
kirc.clean <- new_kirc.clean
```

## DESeq2 processing

### TCGA KIRC - full dataset 
541 patients (ccRCC only)

```{r}
library(DESeq2)

# Create DESeqDataset
ddsSE <- DESeqDataSet(kirc.clean, design = ~ 1) #no design specified - not performing differential expression now
ddsSE

# DESeq analysis includes count normalization based on size factors
res <- DESeq(ddsSE)
rownames(res) <- rowData(res)$gene_name
counts_norm <- counts(res, normalized = TRUE) # Access normalized counts 

# Variance-stabilizing transformation
vsd <- DESeq2::vst(res)

# Access normalized and stabilized counts
mat <- assay(vsd)
```

## ICAM1 and mTOR signature 

### Define groups

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(scater)

counts_norm <- counts(res, normalized = TRUE)
colnames(counts_norm) <- res$PID
rownames(counts_norm)

df_check <- counts_norm %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select("ICAM1", "CD44", "MTOR", "VHL")
rownames(df_check) <- res$PID

df_minmax <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_check, function(x) {
  (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
}))
rownames(df_minmax) <- rownames(df_check)

expr_mat <- t(as.matrix(df_minmax))

# Step 2: Create a new SingleCellExperiment object
sce_minmax <- SingleCellExperiment(
  assays = list(min_max = expr_mat),
  colData = data.frame(PID = rownames(df_minmax), row.names = rownames(df_minmax))
)

# Step 3: Run PCA on subset of genes (e.g., MYC, ICAM1, CCND1)
subset_genes <- c("ICAM1", "CD44", "MTOR", "VHL")
sce_minmax <- runPCA(sce_minmax,
                     exprs_values = "min_max",
                     subset_row = rownames(sce_minmax) %in% subset_genes,
                     name = "PCA_sub")

# Step 4: Visualize PCA colored by marker (e.g., ICAM1 expression)
plotReducedDim(sce_minmax, dimred = "PCA_sub", 
               colour_by = I(assay(sce_minmax, "min_max")["ICAM1", ]))

plotReducedDim(sce_minmax, dimred = "PCA_sub", 
               colour_by = I(assay(sce_minmax, "min_max")["CD44", ]))

plotReducedDim(sce_minmax, dimred = "PCA_sub", 
               colour_by = I(assay(sce_minmax, "min_max")["VHL", ]))

plotReducedDim(sce_minmax, dimred = "PCA_sub", 
               colour_by = I(assay(sce_minmax, "min_max")["MTOR", ]))
```

### Cox models

Univariate

```{r}
## 1. Disease-free interval 
### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here PID_ICAM_mTOR_group)
PID_metagroups <- colData(vsd) %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(PID_ICAM_mTOR_group, PID) %>% 
  group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame

PID_metagroups <- PID_metagroups %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

PID_metagroups <- PID_metagroups %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "PID_ICAM_mTOR_group",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- vsd$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),vsd$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_days <- vsd$OS_days[match(rownames(Cox_df),vsd$PID)]

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df %>% dplyr::select(-status_OS,-OS_days, -Not_ICAM_mTOR_driven) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_days, status_OS) ~ ", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "), "+ Not_ICAM_mTOR_driven"))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_prop <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))

#write.csv(plot_df_prop, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/TNBC/data_analysis/01_figures/supp_tables/TCGA_Cox_Multi_PIDgroups.csv")

#Plot hazard ratios
hr_prop <- ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(group,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
#scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
scale_color_manual(values = c("#377EB8"))+
xlab("Covariates")+
ylab("HR for PID groups")+
theme_classic()+
scale_y_log10()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop
```

Multivariate 

```{r}
## 1. Disease-free interval 
### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here PID_ICAM_mTOR_group)
PID_metagroups <- colData(vsd) %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(PID_ICAM_mTOR_group, PID) %>% 
  group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame

PID_metagroups <- PID_metagroups %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

PID_metagroups <- PID_metagroups %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "PID_ICAM_mTOR_group",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- vsd$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),vsd$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_days <- vsd$OS_days[match(rownames(Cox_df),vsd$PID)]

Cox_df$gender <- vsd$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df),vsd$PID)]
Cox_df$pT_simple <- as.factor(vsd$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),vsd$PID)])
Cox_df$ISUP_simple <- as.factor(vsd$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),vsd$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df %>% dplyr::select(-status_OS,-OS_days, -gender, -pT_simple, -ISUP_simple, -mTOR_driven) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_days, status_OS) ~ gender + pT_simple + ISUP_simple +", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "), "+ mTOR_driven"))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_prop <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))

#write.csv(plot_df_prop, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/TNBC/data_analysis/01_figures/supp_tables/TCGA_Cox_Multi_PIDgroups.csv")

#Plot hazard ratios
hr_prop <- ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(group,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Covariates")+
ylab("HR for PID groups")+
theme_classic()+
scale_y_log10()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop
```

### Marker expression comparison for PID groups 

#### IMC markers 

```{r}
# Define GOI of interest
GOI <- c("CA9", "GPX4", "HLA-DRA", "NFKB1", "CCND1", "HIF1A", "TP53", "MYC", "ICAM1", "PDK4", "NT5E", "SMARCA4", "PKM", "CD274", "MME", "IDH2", "EPAS1", "AURKA", "HAVCR2", "EGFR", "RPS6", "FLT1", "VHL", "RB1", "MTOR", "SLC2A1", "FH", "GLUD1", "CD44", "VIM")

GOI_rel <- GOI[GOI %in% rownames(vsd)]

#c("CA9", "KRT19", "GPX4", "HLA-DRA", "NFKB1", "CCND1", "HIF1A", "TP53", "MYC", "ICAM1", "PDK4", "NT5E", "SMARCA4", "PKM", "CD274", "MME", "IDH2", "EPAS1", "AURKA", "HAVCR2", "EGFR", "RPS6", "FLT1", "VHL", "RB1", "MTOR", "SLC2A1", "FH", "GLUD1", "CD44", "VIM")

# Define heatmap based on normalized counts 
## Option 1: size-factor normalized counts 
#df <- t(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)[GOI,]) %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("PID")
## Option 2: vst counts
df <- t(assay(vsd)[GOI_rel,]) %>% as.data.frame 
df <- df %>% rownames_to_column("PID")

## Create heatmap body 
df$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group <- vsd$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group[match(df$PID, colnames(vsd))]

mat <- df %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:(ncol(df)-1), names_to = "gene", values_to = "exprs") %>% group_by(PID_ICAM_mTOR_group, gene) %>% summarize(mean = mean(exprs))

ht <- mat %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "gene", values_from = "mean") %>% column_to_rownames("PID_ICAM_mTOR_group")

## Create row annotation 
anno <- df %>% select(PID_ICAM_mTOR_group) %>% group_by(PID_ICAM_mTOR_group) %>% dplyr::count()
anno <- anno[match(anno$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group, rownames(ht)),]

## Print heatmap 
Heatmap(ht, name = "Mean Z-scores")

Heatmap(scale(ht), name = "Scaled mean Z-scores")+
  rowAnnotation(n = anno_barplot(anno$n, gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF")))+
  rowAnnotation(anno = anno_text(anno$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group))
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
#HU_SIG <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/data/DCCD_SubTables_NatureGenetics.xlsx",sheet = 8, col_names = TRUE)
HU_SIG <- read_excel("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/data/DCCD_SubTables_NatureGenetics.xlsx",sheet = 8, col_names = TRUE)

# Extract unique signatures genes for each immune subtype
IM4 <- HU_SIG %>% filter(Immune_subtype == "IM4") %>% pull(Symbol) #De-clear differentiated ccRCC
IM3 <- HU_SIG %>% filter(Immune_subtype == "IM3") %>% pull(Symbol)
IM2 <- HU_SIG %>% filter(Immune_subtype == "IM2") %>% pull(Symbol) #Good prognosis
IM1 <- HU_SIG %>% filter(Immune_subtype == "IM1") %>% pull(Symbol)
```

IM4 

```{r}
## 1. pan AV signature per PID group 
IM4_rel <- IM4[IM4 %in% rownames(assay(vsd))]
# Filter for available genes
#TNBC_PID <- colnames(vsd[,vsd$TNBC == "TNBC"])
#vsd_TNBC <- vsd[, colnames(vsd) %in% TNBC_PID]
#df <- t(assay(vsd_TNBC)[IM4_rel ,]) %>% as.data.frame
df <- t(assay(vsd)[IM4_rel ,]) %>% as.data.frame

# Z-score gene expression 
df <- as.data.frame(scale(df))

df$signature_sum <- rowSums(df,na.rm = TRUE)
df$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group <- vsd$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group[match(rownames(df), colnames(vsd))]

compare_means(signature_sum ~ PID_ICAM_mTOR_group,df) #pairwise comparisons
compare_means(signature_sum ~ PID_ICAM_mTOR_group,df, method = "kruskal.test") #global comparison

ggplot(df, aes(x = PID_ICAM_mTOR_group, y = signature_sum))+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID_ICAM_mTOR_group), size = 3, position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA)+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired")+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("IM4 signature (Hu et al.)")+
  stat_compare_means()

mat <- df %>% pivot_longer(cols = 1:(ncol(df)-2), names_to = "gene", values_to = "exprs") %>% group_by(PID_ICAM_mTOR_group, gene) %>% summarize(mean = mean(exprs))
mat <- mat %>% filter(!is.na(mean))
ht <- mat %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "gene", values_from = "mean") %>% column_to_rownames("PID_ICAM_mTOR_group")

Heatmap(ht, name = "Mean signature Z-scores")
```

Sarcomatoid signature 

```{r}
## 1. pan AV signature per PID group 
sarc_sig_rel <- sarc_sig[sarc_sig %in% rownames(assay(vsd))]
# Filter for available genes
#TNBC_PID <- colnames(vsd[,vsd$TNBC == "TNBC"])
#vsd_TNBC <- vsd[, colnames(vsd) %in% TNBC_PID]
#df <- t(assay(vsd_TNBC)[sarc_sig_rel ,]) %>% as.data.frame
df <- t(assay(vsd)[sarc_sig_rel ,]) %>% as.data.frame

# Z-score gene expression 
df <- as.data.frame(scale(df))

df$signature_sum <- rowSums(df,na.rm = TRUE)
df$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group <- vsd$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group[match(rownames(df), colnames(vsd))]

compare_means(signature_sum ~ PID_ICAM_mTOR_group,df) #pairwise comparisons
compare_means(signature_sum ~ PID_ICAM_mTOR_group,df, method = "kruskal.test") #global comparison

ggplot(df, aes(x = PID_ICAM_mTOR_group, y = signature_sum))+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID_ICAM_mTOR_group), size = 3, position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA)+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired")+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("sarc_sig signature (Hu et al.)")+
  stat_compare_means()

mat <- df %>% pivot_longer(cols = 1:(ncol(df)-2), names_to = "gene", values_to = "exprs") %>% group_by(PID_ICAM_mTOR_group, gene) %>% summarize(mean = mean(exprs))
mat <- mat %>% filter(!is.na(mean))
ht <- mat %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "gene", values_from = "mean") %>% column_to_rownames("PID_ICAM_mTOR_group")

Heatmap(ht, name = "Mean signature Z-scores")
```

### Cox models

Univariate

```{r}
## 1. Disease-free interval 
### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here TME_archetype)
PID_metagroups <- colData(vsd) %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(TME_archetype, PID) %>% 
  group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame

PID_metagroups <- PID_metagroups %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

PID_metagroups <- PID_metagroups %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "TME_archetype",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- vsd$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),vsd$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_days <- vsd$OS_days[match(rownames(Cox_df),vsd$PID)]

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df %>% dplyr::select(-status_OS,-OS_days, -TME_silent) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_days, status_OS) ~ ", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "), "+ TME_silent"))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_prop <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))

#write.csv(plot_df_prop, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/TNBC/data_analysis/01_figures/supp_tables/TCGA_Cox_Multi_PIDgroups.csv")

#Plot hazard ratios
hr_prop <- ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(group,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
#scale_color_manual(values = c("#377EB8"))+
xlab("Covariates")+
ylab("HR for PID groups")+
theme_classic()+
scale_y_log10()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop
```

Multivariate 

```{r}
## 1. Disease-free interval 
### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here TME_archetype)
PID_metagroups <- colData(vsd) %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(TME_archetype, PID) %>% 
  group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame

PID_metagroups <- PID_metagroups %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

PID_metagroups <- PID_metagroups %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "TME_archetype",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- vsd$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),vsd$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_days <- vsd$OS_days[match(rownames(Cox_df),vsd$PID)]

Cox_df$gender <- vsd$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df),vsd$PID)]
Cox_df$pT_simple <- as.factor(vsd$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),vsd$PID)])
#Cox_df$ISUP_simple <- as.factor(vsd$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),vsd$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df %>% dplyr::select(-status_OS,-OS_days, -gender, -pT_simple, -TME_silent) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_days, status_OS) ~ gender + pT_simple +", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "), "+ TME_silent"))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_prop <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))

#write.csv(plot_df_prop, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/TNBC/data_analysis/01_figures/supp_tables/TCGA_Cox_Multi_PIDgroups.csv")

#Plot hazard ratios
hr_prop <- ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(group,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Covariates")+
ylab("HR for PID groups")+
theme_classic()+
scale_y_log10()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop
```

```{r}
#df <- t(assay(vsd_TNBC)[IM4_rel ,]) %>% as.data.frame
df <- t(assay(vsd)[IM4_rel ,]) %>% as.data.frame

# Z-score gene expression 
df <- as.data.frame(scale(df))

df$signature_sum <- rowSums(df,na.rm = TRUE)
df$TME_archetype <- vsd$TME_archetype[match(rownames(df), colnames(vsd))]
df <- df[!is.na(df$TME_archetype),]

compare_means(signature_sum ~ TME_archetype,df) #pairwise comparisons
compare_means(signature_sum ~ TME_archetype,df, method = "kruskal.test") #global comparison
col_group <- setNames(c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"),c("TME_activated","TME_silent","TME_suppressed"))


ggplot(df, aes(x = TME_archetype, y = signature_sum, fill = TME_archetype))+
  geom_point(aes(color = TME_archetype))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  #scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired")+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_group)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_group)+
  theme_classic()+
  guides(color = "none")+
  ylab("IM4 signature (Hu et al.)")+
  stat_compare_means()

mat <- df %>% pivot_longer(cols = 1:(ncol(df)-2), names_to = "gene", values_to = "exprs") %>% group_by(TME_archetype, gene) %>% summarize(mean = mean(exprs)) %>% na.omit()
mat <- mat %>% filter(!is.na(mean))
ht <- mat %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "gene", values_from = "mean") %>% column_to_rownames("TME_archetype")

Heatmap(ht, name = "Mean signature Z-scores")
```

## Differential expression analysis

### ICAM1-mTOR groups

```{r}
#kirc.clean <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/TCGA_KIRC/TCGA_KIRC_cleaned.rds")
```

```{r}
library(DESeq2)

kirc.clean <- kirc.clean[,!is.na(kirc.clean$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group)]

# Create DESeqDataset
ddsSE_1 <- DESeqDataSet(kirc.clean, design = ~ PID_ICAM_mTOR_group)

# Filter genes
## 1: Lowly expressed genes
summary(rowSums(counts(ddsSE_1)) >= 10)
keep <- rowSums(counts(ddsSE_1)) >= 10
ddsSE_1 <- ddsSE_1[keep, ]

## 2: Filter for protein-coding genes
library(biomaRt)
out <- data.frame(og = rownames(ddsSE_1),
           sh = sub("\\..*", "", rownames(ddsSE_1)))
ensembl <- useEnsembl(biomart = "genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
gene_info <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "gene_biotype"),
                   filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
                   values = out$sh,
                   mart = ensembl)
out$gene_biotype <- gene_info$gene_biotype[match(out$sh, gene_info$ensembl_gene_id)]
keep_protein_coding <- out %>% filter(gene_biotype == "protein_coding") %>% pull(og)
ddsSE_1 <- ddsSE_1[keep_protein_coding, ]


# Perform DESeq analysis 
## includes count normalization based on size factors
dds <- DESeq(ddsSE_1, )

# Check which specific comparison for downstream analysis
resultsNames(dds)
rownames(dds) <- rowData(dds)$gene_name

# Variance-stabilizing transformation
vsd <- DESeq2::vst(dds)
```

#### NTP - Prediction

```{r}
# Nearest template prediction
library(CMScaller)

# Step 1: Prepare expression matrix (genes x samples, log2 scale)
expr_mat <- assay(vsd)  

tpm_mat <- assays(kirc.clean)$tpm_unstrand 
log2_tpm <- log2(tpm_mat + 1)
expr_mat <- ematAdjust(log2_tpm, method = "RLE")
rownames(expr_mat) <- rowData(kirc.clean)$gene_name

# Step 2: Create subtype templates (Gene signatures)
names(MTORUP) <- rep("MTOR", length(MTORUP))
names(ICAMUP) <- rep("ICAM", length(ICAMUP))
keyup <- c(MTORUP, ICAMUP)

#names(NOTUP) <- rep("NOT", length(NOTUP))
#keyup <- c(MTORUP, ICAMUP, NOTUP)

template_mat <- data.frame(class = factor(names(keyup)), 
           probe = unname(keyup))

# Step 3: Run NTP classification with permutations
ntp_result <- ntp(
  emat = expr_mat,           
  template = template_mat,
  distance = "spearman",
  nPerm = 1000,              
  seed = 22,                 
  nCores = 30,
  doPlot = TRUE
)

ntp_result %>% group_by(prediction) %>% dplyr::count()
```

```{r}
ntp_out <- ntp_result %>% rownames_to_column("PID") %>% mutate(group_predict = ifelse(FDR < 0.01, as.character(prediction), "NOT"))

ntp_out$OS_months <- vsd$OS_days[match(ntp_out$PID, vsd$PID)]
ntp_out$status_OS <- vsd$status_OS[match(ntp_out$PID, vsd$PID)]

fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ group_predict, data = ntp_out)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme¨
          #palette = c("#046C9A", "#000000", "#D69C4E", "#ECCBAE", "#ABDDDE"),
          conf.int = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
kirc.clean$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group_predict <- ntp_out$group_predict[match(kirc.clean$PID, ntp_out$PID)]

kirc.clean$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group_predict[kirc.clean$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group_predict == "ICAM"] <- "ICAM_driven"
kirc.clean$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group_predict[kirc.clean$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group_predict == "NOT"] <- "Not_ICAM_VHL_driven"
kirc.clean$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group_predict[kirc.clean$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group_predict == "MTOR"] <- "MTOR_driven"
kirc.clean$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group_predict <- factor(kirc.clean$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group_predict, levels = levels(kirc.clean$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group))

table(kirc.clean$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group_predict, kirc.clean$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group)
```

#### NTP - Prediction

```{r}
# Nearest template prediction
library(CMScaller)
set.seed(22)

# Step 1: Prepare expression matrix (genes x samples, log2 scale)
tpm_mat <- assays(kirc.clean)$tpm_unstrand 
log2_tpm <- log2(tpm_mat + 1)
expr_mat <- ematAdjust(log2_tpm, method = "RLE")
rownames(expr_mat) <- rowData(kirc.clean)$gene_name

# Step 2: Create subtype templates (Gene signatures)
names(MTORUP) <- rep("MTOR", length(MTORUP))
names(ICAMUP) <- rep("ICAM", length(ICAMUP))
keyup <- c(MTORUP, ICAMUP)

#names(NOTUP) <- rep("NOT", length(NOTUP))
#keyup <- c(MTORUP, ICAMUP, NOTUP)

template_mat <- data.frame(class = factor(names(keyup)), 
           probe = unname(keyup))

# Step 3: Run NTP classification with permutations
ntp_result <- ntp(
  emat = expr_mat,           
  template = template_mat,
  distance = "cosine",
  nPerm = 1000,              
  seed = 22,                 
  doPlot = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(caret)

kirc.clean$TME_archetype <- factor(kirc.clean$TME_archetype)

# Store results
results <- data.frame(FDR_cutoff = numeric(), Mean_Balanced_Accuracy = numeric())

# Loop through FDR cutoffs from 0.05 to 0.01 (step -0.005)
for (fdr_cutoff in c(seq(0.05, 0.001, by = -0.005), 0.0001)) {
  
  # Generate predictions based on current cutoff
  ntp_out <- ntp_result %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("PID") %>%
    mutate(group_predict = ifelse(FDR < fdr_cutoff, as.character(prediction), "NOT"))
  
  # Map predictions to kirc.clean
  kirc.clean$TME_archetype_predict <- ntp_out$group_predict[match(kirc.clean$PID, ntp_out$PID)]
  
  # Rename groups
  kirc.clean$TME_archetype_predict[kirc.clean$TME_archetype_predict == "ICAM"] <- "TME_suppressed"
  kirc.clean$TME_archetype_predict[kirc.clean$TME_archetype_predict == "NOT"] <- "TME_silent"
  kirc.clean$TME_archetype_predict[kirc.clean$TME_archetype_predict == "MTOR"] <- "TME_activated"
  
  # Factor levels
  kirc.clean$TME_archetype_predict <- factor(kirc.clean$TME_archetype_predict, levels = levels(kirc.clean$TME_archetype))
  
  # Generate confusion matrix
  cm <- confusionMatrix(data = kirc.clean$TME_archetype_predict, 
                        reference = kirc.clean$TME_archetype, 
                        mode = "everything")
  
  # Extract and store mean balanced accuracy
  cm_stats <- as.data.frame(cm$byClass)
  mean_ba <- mean(cm_stats$`Balanced Accuracy`, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_f1 <- mean(cm_stats$F1, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(FDR_cutoff = fdr_cutoff, 
                                       Mean_Balanced_Accuracy = mean_ba, 
                                       mean_f1 = mean_f1))
}
```

IM4 

```{r}
## 1. pan AV signature per PID group 
IM4_rel <- IM4[IM4 %in% rownames(assay(vsd))]
# Filter for available genes
#TNBC_PID <- colnames(vsd[,vsd$TNBC == "TNBC"])
#vsd_TNBC <- vsd[, colnames(vsd) %in% TNBC_PID]
#df <- t(assay(vsd_TNBC)[IM4_rel ,]) %>% as.data.frame
df <- t(assay(vsd)[IM4_rel ,]) %>% as.data.frame

# Z-score gene expression 
df <- as.data.frame(scale(df))

df$signature_sum <- rowSums(df,na.rm = TRUE)
df$TME_archetype_predict <- vsd$TME_archetype_predict[match(rownames(df), colnames(vsd))]
df <- df[!is.na(df$TME_archetype_predict),]

compare_means(signature_sum ~ TME_archetype_predict,df) #pairwise comparisons
compare_means(signature_sum ~ TME_archetype_predict,df, method = "kruskal.test") #global comparison
col_group <- setNames(c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"),c("TME_activated","TME_silent","TME_suppressed"))

pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/TCGA_KIRC/TCGA_KIRC_archetype_IM4Hu_box.pdf", width = 5, height = 3)
ggplot(df, aes(x = TME_archetype_predict, y = signature_sum, fill = TME_archetype_predict))+
  geom_point(aes(color = TME_archetype_predict))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  #scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired")+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_group)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_group)+
  theme_classic()+
  guides(color = "none")+
  ylab("IM4 signature (Hu et al.)")+
  stat_compare_means()
dev.off()

mat <- df %>% pivot_longer(cols = 1:(ncol(df)-2), names_to = "gene", values_to = "exprs") %>% group_by(TME_archetype_predict, gene) %>% summarize(mean = mean(exprs)) %>% na.omit()
mat <- mat %>% filter(!is.na(mean))
ht <- mat %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "gene", values_from = "mean") %>% column_to_rownames("TME_archetype_predict")

Heatmap(ht, name = "Mean signature Z-scores")
```

```{r}
Heatmap(ht, name = "Mean signature Z-scores")
```

### TME archetype

```{r}
kirc.clean <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/TCGA_KIRC/TCGA_KIRC_cleaned.rds")
```

```{r}
library(DESeq2)

kirc.clean.fil <- kirc.clean[,!is.na(kirc.clean$TME_archetype)]

# Create DESeqDataset
ddsSE_1 <- DESeqDataSet(kirc.clean.fil, design = ~ TME_archetype)

# Filter genes
summary(rowSums(counts(ddsSE_1)) >= 10)
keep <- rowSums(counts(ddsSE_1)) >= 10
ddsSE_1 <- ddsSE_1[keep, ]

# DESeq analysis includes count normalization based on size factors
dds <- DESeq(ddsSE_1, )

# Check which specific comparison for downstream analysis
resultsNames(dds)
rownames(dds) <- rowData(dds)$gene_name

# Extract results - also performs independent filtering
res <- DESeq2::results(dds, name = "TME_archetype_TME_suppressed_vs_TME_activated", alpha = 0.05, lfcThreshold = 1) #alpha = 0.05, 
#res <- DESeq2::results(dds, contrast = c("TME_archetype", "TME_silent", "TME_suppressed"), alpha = 0.05, lfcThreshold = 1) #alpha = 0.05, 
# Variance-stabilizing transformation
vsd <- DESeq2::vst(dds)
```

## GSEA 

With `clusterProfiler`. 

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

organism <- "org.Hs.eg.db"

# Prepare input gene list based on log2foldchanges 
original_gene_list <- res$log2FoldChange
names(original_gene_list) <- rownames(res)
gene_list <- na.omit(original_gene_list)
gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE) # sort in decreasing order

# Run GO analysis
gse <- gseGO(geneList=gene_list, 
             ont ="BP", 
             keyType = "SYMBOL", 
             minGSSize = 50, 
             maxGSSize = 1000, 
             pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
             verbose = TRUE, 
             OrgDb = organism, 
             pAdjustMethod = "BH")

# Visualization
## Dot plot
dotplot(gse, showCategory=10, split=".sign") + facet_grid(~.sign)

## Emap plot
emapplot(pairwise_termsim(gse), showCategory = 15, color = "enrichmentScore", layout = "circle")

## GSEA plot
# gseaplot2(gse, title = gse$Description[9], geneSetID = 1)
# gseaplot2(gse, title = gse$Description[10], geneSetID = 1)
# gseaplot2(gse, title = gse$Description[14], geneSetID = 1)
```

## KEGG pathway enrichment 

With `clusterProfiler`. 

```{r}
# KEGG requires Entrez IDs 
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

entrez.ids <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys=rownames(res), column="ENTREZID", keytype="SYMBOL")
entrez.ids <- entrez.ids[!duplicated(entrez.ids)]

df <- data.frame(log_change = gene_list, 
           SYMBOL = names(gene_list))

df$ENTREZ <- entrez.ids[match(df$SYMBOL, names(entrez.ids))]
df <- df[!is.na(df$ENTREZ),]

gene_list_kegg <- df$log_change
names(gene_list_kegg) <- df$ENTREZ

# Run KEGG
gseKEGG <- gseKEGG(geneList=gene_list_kegg, 
        organism = "hsa",
        keyType = "kegg", 
        minGSSize = 100, 
        maxGSSize = 1000, 
        pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
        verbose = TRUE, 
        pAdjustMethod = "BH")

# Visualization 
## Dotplot 
dotplot(gseKEGG, showCategory = 10, title = "Enriched Pathways" , split=".sign") + facet_grid(.~.sign)

## EMAP plot 
emapplot(pairwise_termsim(gseKEGG), showCategory = 15,color = "enrichmentScore", layout = "circle")

## GSEA plot
gseaplot2(gseKEGG, title = gseKEGG$Description[4], geneSetID = 1)
gseaplot2(gseKEGG, title = gseKEGG$Description[12], geneSetID = 1)
gseaplot2(gseKEGG, title = gseKEGG$Description[20], geneSetID = 1)
```

### MCP-counter 

```{r}
res_MCP <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/TCGA_KIRC/TCGA_KIRC_res_MCP.rds") 

#Z-scoring of MCP results by cell type
res_MCP_1 <- res_MCP %>% dplyr::select(-cell_type)
rownames(res_MCP_1) <- res_MCP$cell_type
res_MCP_z <- as.data.frame(t(scale(t(res_MCP_1), center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)))
res_MCP_z <- res_MCP_z %>% rownames_to_column("cell_type")

res_MCP_plot <- res_MCP_z %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(res_MCP_z), names_to = "PID", values_to = "score")

res_MCP_plot$TME_archetype <- kirc.clean$TME_archetype[match(res_MCP_plot$PID, colnames(kirc.clean))]

ggplot(res_MCP_plot, aes(x = TME_archetype, y = score))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = TME_archetype), size = 3, position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  facet_wrap(~cell_type, scales = "free_y")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  guides(color = "none")
  #stat_compare_means(method = "t.test")
  
# Heatmap visualization  
ht_MCP <- res_MCP_plot %>% group_by(TME_archetype, cell_type) %>% dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(score)) %>% na.omit() %>% pivot_wider(names_from = TME_archetype, values_from = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("cell_type") 

Heatmap(ht_MCP, name = "mean MCP-Z-score")
```

```{r}
# Patient group info 
cur_groups <- colData(vsd) %>% as.data.frame%>% select(PID, ICAM1_driven, MTOR_driven, 
Not_ICAM_mTOR_driven) %>% unique()

# Binary mutation matrix
## Here GOI clonal 
cur_mut_clonal <- colData(vsd) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, VHL_wildtype, VHL_monodriver, BAP1_driven, PBRM1_driven, multiple_drivers) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% filter(complete.cases(.)) %>% t()

cur_groups <- cur_groups[cur_groups$PID %in% colnames(cur_mut_clonal),]

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("ICAM1_driven", "MTOR_driven", 
"Not_ICAM_mTOR_driven"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_mut_clonal, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.1, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.1, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

# Replace INF values with max
fisher_full$odds_ratio[fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf] <- max(fisher_full$odds_ratio[!fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf])

## hierarchical clustering on odds_ratio
cur_df <- fisher_full %>% select(gene, category, odds_ratio) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = odds_ratio, names_from = gene)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x=category, y = gene,col = odds_ratio, size = -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```
